title: Calculate impervious surface area per parcel
output_type: vector (parcels joined with tabulated class areas)
method: Tabulate Area of impervious.tif (0.5 ft cells; VAT: Value 0 = Impervious, 1 = Pervious, 255 = NoData) within each of the 121 parcels (cell-centre rule), areas in ft2 as VALUE_0 / VALUE_1, joined to the parcels on Parcel_ID and saved.
benchmark_defects: The class coding is counter-intuitive (0 = Impervious, 1 = Pervious) and is documented only in impervious.tif.vat.dbf, not in the task text.
The instruction names no output file (the benchmark's script writes output/parcels_joint.shp).
checks: required: a saved vector layer with one feature per parcel (121 +/- 2)

required: a column proportional to the gold impervious (Value 0) area in a known unit (ft2, m2, acres, ha, km2, cell count) within 5 % (or within half a boundary ring of cells = parcel perimeter x 0.25 ft) for >= 90 % of parcels
optional: code reads the class meaning from the VAT
unit-declaring column names are read in their unit; a layer is rejected if a named impervious column is wrong in its declared unit
